typography.guidelines: Do not use Inter. Playfair Display must be used for all H1-H3 to impart the ancient, premium, spiritual look. Manrope for clean, legible data and body copy.

colors.guidelines: Strict dark theme. Archetype: Luxury. Deep Obsidian base with pure Gold (#D4AF37) accents. Never use pure black #000000, use #0a0a09 (tinted warm black). Apply gold text only for emphasis (Bej mantras, highlights).

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Glassmorphism for floating nav and interactive bead selector: bg-[#121211]/60 backdrop-blur-xl border border-[#d4af37]/20.
visual_enhancers.textures: Include a fixed background with a very subtle noise/grain filter (opacity 0.03) to kill digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use 1px borders colored with border-white/10 or border-primary/20. No harsh standard borders.

component_name.Hero3D: Fixed R3F Canvas showing the floating Rudraksha. HTML overlay with Title and Subtitle.
component_name.MalaAssembly: Scroll-triggered section where 108 beads (or representative loop) assemble. Use R3F.
component_name.InteractiveBeadSelector: Split layout. Interactive sidebar of 16 slots (1-14 Mukhi, Ganesh, Gaurishankar). Central display updates text and R3F bead focus.
component_name.CelebrityStories: Large immersive cards with portrait images, quotes, and smooth fade-in.
component_name.EnquiryForm: Shadcn Form inside a Glassmorphism card.
component_name.WhatsAppFloat: Fixed bottom-right corner FAB with pulse animation.

grids.features: Bento Grid Protocol: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Mix spans (col-span-8, col-span-4) for asynchronous visual tension.
grids.experts: grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Dense but breathable.

layouts.spacing: Extremely generous. py-24 to py-32 for main sections. Allow the 3D canvas to breathe. Don't cram text.
layouts.alignment: Mobile-first. Keep text left-aligned for long copy, center-aligned only for massive hero headers or section titles.

motion.3d_scroll: Link Framer Motion's useScroll with R3F using framer-motion-3d or @react-three/drei ScrollControls.
motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on cards: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and glow (shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(212,175,55,0.15)]).
motion.stagger: Fade up elements using Framer Motion with 0.1s stagger on children.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on #0a0a09 background passes APCA. Gold #d4af37 must be large enough if used for text.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the 3D scene (fallback to static rendering).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid.

media.strategy: High-end portrait photography for experts. Dark abstract textures for section grounding.

image_urls.description: Premium dark textured wall for overlay backgrounds
Wooden beads for fallback imagery where 3D is not loaded

3d_libraries.implementation: MOCKED 3D ASSETS: We do not have a .glb file. You MUST mock the Rudraksha using `<Sphere args={[1, 64, 64]}>` combined with `<MeshDistortMaterial color='#4a2010' distort={0.3} speed={1} roughness={0.9} />` from @react-three/drei to simulate the textured organic surface. For the scroll integration, use `<ScrollControls pages={5}>` from Drei, and place the UI sections inside `<Scroll html>`. Bind the bead's rotation and Y-position to the scroll offset using `useScroll`.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Build the frontend using React (.js/.jsx), NOT TypeScript (.tsx). 2. Create a global R3F Canvas covering the screen (fixed inset-0, z-[-1]). 3. Implement `<ScrollControls>` to drive the 3D bead animation (falling, rotating) as the user scrolls through the HTML pages overlaid via `<Scroll html>`. 4. In the Interactive Bead Selector, use state to highlight the active slot, and smoothly transition the bead's material/texture properties based on the selected Mukhi. 5. Include an enquiry form with Shadcn components (Form, Input, Textarea, Button). 6. Use `react-fast-marquee` for the Trusted By section. 7. Do not use generic Shadcn borders/colors, strictly follow the luxury dark/gold palette.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid 'AI slop'. No generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, or uniform styling. Create depth using glass-morphism (backdrop-blur-xl) and z-index layers. DO NOT apply universal transition (`transition: all`). Apply transitions to specific properties. DO NOT use emojis for icons (use lucide-react). Implement Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling. Prioritize UI uniqueness.
GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (kebab-case, role-based) for testing. DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for overlays or headers. Ensure 4.5:1 contrast for text. Use optical alignment (e.g., icons in buttons). Ensure spacing multipliers are generous (p-8 to p-12).
